args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring (and the
nightly tests) expecting banker's rounding. Switch the quantize call
to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66, matching
tests/test_money.py and FIN-212.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switched `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Behavior
- `2.675` → `2.68`
- `2.665` → `2.66` (banker's rounding)

## CI
CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd59`.

cc @alex for review.
